development.interpretation: Boundary proximity alone was insufficient under the frozen rival-selection criterion; mediator-family BASE search-load geometry added the only qualifying >=0.10 LOEO improvement. Broader chess context and engine identity did not clear incremental selection gates.

prediction_seal_attempt.note: Predictions were mechanically computed on 28 structurally eligible cells but receive no held-out scientific vote because the presealed support minimum failed before outcome opening.

scientific_conclusion: P22 identifies a development activation-field candidate in which BASE boundary geometry plus mediator-family search load outperforms boundary-only prediction under the frozen LOEO criterion.

Prospective external validation cannot open because deterministic ROUTED-chain construction reduces the held-out evaluation surface from 58 pair-qualified cells to 28 cells, below the frozen minimum of 36.
The HOLD is upstream of activation outcomes: no held-out FULL_CLASS intervention was opened.
Therefore the development R1 field is neither confirmed nor falsified by P22.

The limiting object is now support constitution: activation-field validation requires an acquisition rule that prospectively guarantees enough ROUTED-chain-realizable engine×world×family cells without conditioning on activation outcomes.
claim_ceiling: Do not claim held-out activation transport.
Do not score the 28 provisional predictions against FULL_CLASS outcomes.
Do not lower the 36-cell gate or add worlds within P22 after seeing chain support.
Do not interpret the R1 tree thresholds as universal constants or causal mechanisms.
Do not route Q0-fiber authority from the development field.
